scripts.build:ingest: rm -rf ingest/dist && bun build ingest/src/handler.ts ingest/src/rebuild-handler.ts --target=node --format=esm --external '@aws-sdk/*' --sourcemap=linked --outdir=ingest/dist --entry-naming=[name].mjs
scripts.build:engine: rm -rf engine/dist && cd engine && uv export --frozen --no-dev --no-hashes --no-emit-project -o dist/requirements.txt && uv pip install --quiet --target dist --python-platform aarch64-manylinux_2_28 --python-version 3.13 -r dist/requirements.txt && cp -r src/battery dist/ && find dist -name __pycache__ -prune -exec rm -rf {} +
scripts.deploy:data: bun run build:ingest && bun run build:engine && uvx --from aws-sam-cli sam deploy
